correctness.rationale: PASS: The 28 rational bitangents have 378 line pairs, giving 6h+3e+f=378 for multiplicities four, three and two. Fullness forces all rational branch points onto bitangents; double-cover fibers give #S=2#U-N=q²+8q+1 and (q-24)²+N=6h+2e-125. From f>=0, 6h+2e<=252+2h. Kuwata Theorem 5.1 gives a distinct involution from each fourfold bitangent intersection in characteristic !=2; Dolgachev–Martin tame characteristic-37 lifting and the complex genus-three involution cap yield h<=21. Thus RHS incidence 6h+2e<=294, but at q=37 fullness requires 294+N. Hasse–Weil gives N>=ceil(38-6sqrt(37))=2, contradiction. All quantifiers explicitly split/full and q37. Independently enumerated 2,332 admissible incidence triples and maximum 294; this cannot verify geometric lemmas.
